method: Public documentation reads through web tool only; no authenticated API requests. Summaries below are interpretations, not full page snapshots.

facts: ObjectPath request is a newline-separated string for batch URLs.
RefreshTaskId response is a comma-separated string.
Same-domain URL submissions in one second are grouped into a task; groups split at 2000 URLs.
sources.does_not_define: Post-submission per-URL query row encoding for grouped tasks.

facts: TaskId request allows up to 10 comma-separated IDs.
Response declares Tasks array, TotalCount, and per-row string TaskId/ObjectPath plus status/type.
sources.does_not_define: Grouped row cardinality, delimiters inside ObjectPath, pagination/truncation of grouped members, or exclusive ownership by one submission.

facts: Supports simultaneous TaskId and exact ObjectPath filtering.
Response uses Tasks.CDNTask with PageNumber/PageSize/TotalCount; page size at most100.
Query retention is three days and rate limit is5 requests/second.
